description: This file defines the OA_Dll_Variable class, which manages variables within the Revive Adserver platform. It includes methods for validation, modification, deletion, and retrieval of variable data, as well as handling permissions and linking variables to websites.

classes.name: OA_Dll_Variable
classes.description: Class for managing variables in the Revive Adserver, including validation, modification, deletion, and retrieval, with permission checks and website linking.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates variable data, checking required fields, data types, and purposes.

methods.name: checkDataType
methods.description: Checks if the dataType field has a valid value ('numeric', 'string', 'date').

methods.name: checkPurpose
methods.description: Checks if the purpose field has a valid value ('basket_value', 'num_items', 'post_code').

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Adds or updates a variable, handling permissions, validation, and website visibility.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a variable after permission check.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Retrieves variable information and populates an OA_Dll_VariableInfo object.

methods.name: updateOtherVariablesIsUniqueValue
methods.description: Sets all other variables for a tracker to is_unique=0, except the specified variable.

methods.name: getLinkedWebsites
methods.description: Returns a list of website IDs linked to a tracker.

methods.name: addVisibleWebsite
methods.description: Makes a variable visible to a specific website.

methods.name: clearVisibleWebsites
methods.description: Removes visibility of a variable from all websites.
